name: Minimalist Budget & Goals Planner
niche: personal finance / monthly budgeting + life-goal tracking spreadsheets (Excel)
targetCustomer: UK adults ~25-45 who want a classic all-in-one budget workbook — a Transactions-List-driven budget dashboard with real charts — plus a lightweight way to track a handful of life goals alongside the numbers.
description: TEST/REVIEW build, v5. Functionally a near-exact recreation of a third-party reference budget workbook (inspected read-only, never modified, never redistributed, no branding carried over) — same categories, same Transactions-List-driven Actuals, same non-CSE ranking engine as v4. STRUCTURE: 3 sheets (Instructions / Budget / BONUS - Goal Tracker); Budget is one workspace: a KPI band, 2 native charts (Cash Flow bar with inline value labels + a Where My Money Went doughnut with a live centre total), Cash Flow Summary, an Available to Spend feature, a 3-across x 2-row grid of category tables (Income/Expense/Bill, then Savings/Debt/ranked Where My Money Went), and a full-width Transactions List every Actual is SUMIF'd from. DESIGN (v5, owner request 2026-09-15): reskinned to the LumiumX house register — the same warm-ivory/terracotta/sage palette and card language as Product #001 — replacing v4's third-party rose/sage recreation, per a LumiumX-branded reference mockup the owner supplied. FUNCTIONALITY: 3 native Excel charts (2 on Budget + 1 doughnut on Goal Tracker; v4 shipped 4 on Budget — Income Breakdown/Actual Allocation dropped as redundant with tables already on the page, no data lost) via the same @dpf/spreadsheet native-chart capability, extended this revision with optional data labels and titled/legended doughnuts. Not carried over: shop branding/links/photos, the reference's live currency-symbol fan-out (GBP-hard instead, house convention), and its full ~500-row blank padding (reduced, same categories/mechanics) — unchanged from v4. See ADR-021 (v4) and ADR-022 (v5).

spreadsheet.note: Built by products/006-*/xlsx/ via @dpf/spreadsheet. Theme is overridden per-product (not the engine DEFAULT_THEME) — v5 (ADR-022) uses the LumiumX house register (same hexes as Product #001), superseding v4's rose/sage recreation (ADR-021, which itself superseded ADR-020's sage-green card-adaptation direction). @dpf/spreadsheet's native Excel chart injection (spreadsheet/src/engine/native-charts.mjs, injectNativeCharts/countChartParts/withPreviewPaperSize), first built for v4, gained two more additive capabilities this revision: bar-chart data labels and titled/legended/multi-slice doughnuts — ExcelJS has no API to write charts at all, so these hand-author the OOXML chart/drawing parts and splice them into the built .xlsx.

designSystem.note: v5 (ADR-022): the LumiumX house register — the same warm-ivory/terracotta/sage palette, typography and card language as Product #001 — replacing v4's hex-for-hex recreation of the reference workbook's own rose/sage visual system (ADR-021). No solid section-band fills; section headings are plain tracked caps + a hairline. KPI cards get a soft family-tinted fill (income=plain, spending pools=pale terracotta, savings=pale sage) + a hairline frame, not a saturated block. Category cells have no colour chip. Progress is still a native Excel data bar, now in the sage accent. 3 native charts (2 on Budget + 1 doughnut on Goal Tracker) render real proportional data, not decorative placeholders.
designSystem.progress: native Excel data bar (conditional formatting), sage accent colour
designSystem.navigation: native sheet tabs, terracotta/sage phase colour

pages.title: Instructions
pages.purpose: Quick walkthrough: how the workbook flows, the cell-colour key, a Different Transaction Types glossary, a worked example, printing tips. No third-party branding or links.

pages.title: Budget
pages.purpose: THE PRODUCT. Budget period + rollover, a 4-card KPI band (Income/Expenses & Bills/Debt Payments/Savings), 2 native charts (Cash Flow bar + Where My Money Went doughnut), Cash Flow Summary, an Available to Spend feature, a 3-across x 2-row grid of category tables (Income Summary/Expense Summary/Bill Tracker, then Savings Tracker/Debt Payments Tracker/ranked Where My Money Went), and a full-width Transactions List every Actual column is SUMIF'd from.

pages.title: BONUS - Goal Tracker
pages.purpose: Areas-of-Life roll-up + a native doughnut overall-progress ring, plus an 8-row goals table (life area, goal, reward, deadline, status, steps-done/steps-total progress).

metadata.approvedFrom: Owner request 2026-09-13/14/15, five rounds: (1) 'Product 1 design x Product 5 functionality' recombination. (2) Correction: Product #1's current card-based 'Digital Stationery' design (ADR-018) is the reference, adapt as far as Excel allows. (3) Correction: recreate the reference workbook's actual 3-sheet structure with Budget as one dense workspace. (4) Correction (2026-09-14), having reviewed the reference file directly: 'make it exactly like this' — its own rose/sage design, its three-column-zone structure, Transactions-List-driven Actuals, and (explicitly chosen over a data-bar fallback when asked) real native Excel charts. (5) Correction (2026-09-15), having reviewed a LumiumX-branded reference mockup: reskin to the LumiumX house register (Product #001's palette/typography), keeping v4's functionality intact. See ADR-021 (v4) and ADR-022 (v5).
metadata.engineChanges: @dpf/spreadsheet's native-charts.mjs (injectNativeCharts/countChartParts/withPreviewPaperSize), first built for v4, gained two more additive capabilities in v5: bar-chart data labels (showValues) and titled/legended/multi-slice doughnuts (title/categoriesRef/legendPos) — both optional, default output unchanged for existing callers. jszip is an explicit dependency (was already an ExcelJS transitive one).
openQuestions: Awaiting owner visual + functional sign-off before any Etsy listing work begins. Nothing in this product's pipeline creates an Etsy draft.

Whether this LumiumX house register should now be treated as settled for all spreadsheet products (it already is for #001); the owner has indicated future colour variants of this same structure may be requested.
